title: Note transcript
description: POST /v1/notes/transcribe (body: the recorded audio, e.g. audio/webm or audio/mp4). The words of a voice note, from speech-to-text. The audio is not kept. Feed the text to POST /v1/notes/sort to fill the form.

text.description: The transcript, with filler words and false starts removed. Empty if no speech was heard.

language_code.description: The detected language (ISO 639-3, e.g. 'eng'), or null if not reported.

example.description: True when the server has no speech-to-text service and returned a fixed example transcript instead of the recording's words.
